purpose: Verified Burlington-area events that supplement the main Explore calendar. Burlington remains the priority; nearby Oakville and Hamilton listings are included when practical for Burlington readers.

events.title: Oak Park Fall Fair
events.location: Oak Park Neighbourhood Centre, 2200 Sawgrass Drive, Oakville
events.travel: About 20 minutes east of central Burlington
events.summary: A free community fair with inflatables, entertainers, exhibitors, an auction and an evening outdoor movie.
events.details: The Oak Park Neighbourhood Centre lists its 29th annual fall fair for September 12. Daytime programming includes family activities, exhibitors and entertainment, followed by an outdoor movie in the evening.
bring: A payment card for food or the auction
A chair or blanket if staying for the movie
events.sourceName: Oak Park Neighbourhood Centre; checked against Visit Oakville
events.imageAlt: A community gathering in a neighbourhood park.

events.title: Movie Night in Hendrie Park
events.location: Hendrie Park, Royal Botanical Gardens, 680 Plains Road West
events.travel: West Burlington, beside the RBG Centre
events.summary: A Green Angels fundraiser with Hoppers, family activities, lawn games and complimentary popcorn.
events.details: Royal Botanical Gardens lists admission from 5:30 p.m. and the film at approximately 7:20 p.m., once light levels allow. The event is rain or shine and can move indoors in bad weather.
events.imageAlt: An outdoor movie screen set up in a community park.

events.title: Salsa Saturday on the Waterfront
events.location: Pier 8 Outdoor Skating Rink, 47 Discovery Drive, Hamilton
events.travel: About 20 minutes from Burlington outside peak traffic
events.summary: A free beginner lesson followed by outdoor waterfront dancing. No partner or experience is required.
events.details: The City of Hamilton lists a beginner Latin dance lesson from 7 to 7:30 p.m., followed by dancing at the Pier 8 roller rink until 10:30 p.m.
